author.name: Gita Ramesh
author.jobTitle: Co-Founder & Joint Managing Director, Kairali Ayurvedic Group

books.title: Ayurvedic Herbal Massage
books.subtitle: With an easy-to-do self-massage programme
books.coverAlt: Front cover of Ayurvedic Herbal Massage by Gita Ramesh — a woman receiving a head massage, pink flowers laid in her dark hair, Roli Books
books.blurb: Her first book: the oils, the strokes, and the sequence of classical Ayurvedic herbal massage, with a self-massage programme anyone can follow at home.
about: Published in 2000, Ayurvedic Herbal Massage introduced readers to the therapy Kairali is built around — herbal-oil massage as practised in Kerala, photographed step by step across 84 pages.
The book pairs each technique with the classical reasoning behind it and closes with an easy-to-do self-massage programme, written for readers with no prior exposure to Ayurveda.

books.title: The Ayurvedic Cookbook
books.subtitle: Get Fit in Just Two Weeks
books.coverAlt: Front cover of The Ayurvedic Cookbook: Get Fit in Just Two Weeks by Gita Ramesh, Roli Books
books.blurb: Vegetarian recipes arranged by constitution — vata, pitta, kapha — with the Healing Village's two-week meal chart as a ready reckoner.
about: First published by Roli Books and reissued in this second edition in 2019 (US edition 2020, distributed by Simon & Schuster), The Ayurvedic Cookbook sets out everyday vegetarian cooking the Ayurvedic way: dishes matched to the three constitutions, with the meal plans used at Kairali — The Ayurvedic Healing Village printed as a two-week chart.
“This book translates ancient knowledge into a practical, easy-to-follow guide with simple recipes.” — Dr. P.R. Krishnakumar, Arya Vaidya Pharmacy Group, printed on the publisher's page.

books.title: The Ayurvedic Wellness Cookbook
books.subtitle: Recipes for Balance & Rejuvenation
books.coverAlt: Front cover of The Ayurvedic Wellness Cookbook: Recipes for Balance & Rejuvenation by Gita Ramesh, Roli Books
books.award: Gourmand World Cookbook Award 2023 — Best in the World
books.blurb: Soups, stews and beverages composed for the body's constitution — named Best in the World at the Gourmand World Cookbook Awards 2023.
about: Written during the lockdown and published by Roli Books in 2022, The Ayurvedic Wellness Cookbook carries the Healing Village's wellness kitchen into home cooking — recipes for balance across the constitutions, from morning beverages to full meals.
In July 2023 it was named Best in the World at the Gourmand World Cookbook Awards, presented at the Umeå Food Symposium in Sweden — a win reported by The Hindu.

pressLinks.label: The Hindu — “An Ayurvedic cookbook wins the Gourmand World Cookbook Award 2023”

books.title: Harmony
books.subtitle: Essential Ayurveda for All
books.coverAlt: Front cover of Harmony: Essential Ayurveda for All by Gita Ramesh — a watercolour wreath of flowers, herbs and fruit on a vermilion ground, Roli Books
books.blurb: Her fourth book, and the widest in scope: food, yoga, mental wellness and home practice, organised around the three doshas as blueprints for daily life.
about: Published by Roli Books in April 2026, Harmony: Essential Ayurveda for All steps beyond the kitchen — 280 pages across food, yoga, mental wellness and home remedies, with the three doshas read as personal blueprints and recipes composed for specific imbalances.
The international edition reached stores on 14 July 2026; the US trade edition follows on 28 July 2026 through ACC Art Books.
